item.title: Profitting from the high cost of energy
item.author: The Daily Telegraph
item.description: The easiest way to buy into energy stocks is through an exchange-traded fund such as the Xtrackers MSCI World Energy UCITS ETF, the largest fund by far. It's up a whopping 54pc year to date and 165pc over the last five years. As an aside, the main ETF tracking only US energy majors, the iShares S&P 500 Energy Sector UCITS ETF, is up even more year-to-date, at 58pc.
